checkpoints.prompt: Judge eligibility using the single supplied current observation. Earlier checkpoints are independent questions. For an ineligible record, decline with reason not_eligible, no quantity, no operands, no selected trials, and choose the one applicable finding: native_rate_unverified, declared_geometry_required or failed_signal_qc. A processed/interpolated record or disagreement among observed, declared and metadata native rates cannot enter the native method. Any required record-wide quality flag failure disqualifies the observation before computation. Return one JSON object with version m5.measurement-answer.v1, decision (compute or refuse), method, reason (eligible for a computation), selected_trials, citations, claims, quantity and operands. Use string arrays for selected_trials, citations and claims. Each operand has artifact, field, and numeric value. A computed quantity has numeric value and uncertainty, plus unit, dimension and estimand strings. When refusing, use null for quantity and empty arrays for operands and selected_trials. Cite DEV-005 and CX-003 in all decisions. DEV-005 describes method- and condition-specific GNSS/LPS results and distinguishes positional and Doppler observations. CX-003 documents acquisition and processing dependence of GNSS-derived external-load metrics. Use method enu-positional-speed. For an eligible synthetic WGS84 record, report horizontal_positional_speed in m/s (dimension speed) at row r using the unfiltered centered three-point derivative in the declared local ENU frame. At this equatorial origin the north component is zero, and east is (6378137 m + ellipsoidal height) times sin(longitude minus origin longitude). Use the reference measurement clock, applying declared affine drift and subtracting constant receipt latency where present. A constant offset and latency leave elapsed spans unchanged. Report the conditional conservative position error radius 4e/h, with e=horizontal_error_m in the ENU plane and h the minimum admitted reference step. This scale covers the full grid under exact timestamps and fixed sample membership. Use ordered raw operands: time, latitude, longitude and height at rows r−1, r, r+1 in channel order with keys like time.4, then horizontal_error_m. Select the current artifact name as the sole trial. Decide compute only with claims antenna_horizontal_positional_speed, doppler_separate_estimand and fixed_grid_bound.

methods.sampling: Contiguous uniform native 25 Hz in source clock; fixed interior row; unfiltered
methods.clock: Exact shared measurement clock or exact bracketed affine receiver mapping and fixed receipt latency
methods.geometry: Equatorial WGS84 fixes, explicit ENU origin, horizontal synthetic antenna-point displacement
methods.qc: Production native admission, WGS84 origin, timestamp-rate compatibility and all GNSS quality channels
methods.eligibility: Synthetic native observation with internally consistent rate, ENU frame, coherent Doppler metadata and quality across the record
methods.uncertainty: Conditional conservative speed radius from declared horizontal ENU position error balls with fixed rows and exact admitted timestamps
limitations: Antenna horizontal positional speed and Doppler speed are distinct estimands; neither identifies athlete centre-of-mass speed.
The bound assumes exact timing and fixed membership with declared position errors. It gives no empirical receiver accuracy or paired-device inference.
